# Age of Information (AoI) Analysis Library

This is a Python port of the Age of Information analysis code originally
implemented in MATLAB as part of the LINE solver:

- `matlab/lib/thirdparty/aoi/`
- `matlab/lib/aoi/`

The library provides analytical methods for computing Age of Information
metrics in queueing systems, including bufferless and single-buffer models,
Laplace-Stieltjes transform utilities, and validation routines.

## Origin

This code is a derivative work ported from MATLAB to Python for use in the
native Python implementation of the LINE solver. The original MATLAB source
is located in the LINE solver repository under the paths listed above.
